actions.name: addToList
actions.title: Add to List
actions.description: Adds the input item to the given list. Even though the description says this action accepts input of type "Files", it accepts any type.
actions.example: addToList(list: [ShortcutInput, CurrentDate], item: Clipboard, prepend: false)

actions.name: applyCaptureDate
actions.title: Apply Capture Date
actions.description: Applies the original capture date & time of the photo (from Exif metadata) to the file's creation and modification date. actions.name: dateToUnixTime
actions.title: Date to Unix Time
actions.description: Gets the Unix time for the input date. Write "now" as the date to get it for the currentdate and time. Unix time (also known as Epoch time) is a system for describing a point in time — the number of seconds that have elapsed since the Unix epoch.

actions.name: formatCurrency
actions.title: Format Currency
actions.description: Formats the input amount as currency. If a currency is not specified, it uses the currency of the system ActionsLocale.

actions.name: formatDateDifference

actions.name: generateUUID

actions.name: getFileIcon

actions.name: getFilePath

actions.name: getMusicPlaylists

actions.name: getRunningApps

actions.name: getTitleOfURL

actions.name: getUserDetails

actions.description: Hides the Shortcuts app. This is useful for making cross-platform shortcuts. If you just target iOS, use the built-in “Go to Home Screen” action instead.

actions.name: isAudioPlaying
actions.title: Is Audio Playing (iOS-only)
actions.description: Returns whether there is audio playing on the device.

actions.name: isBluetoothOn
actions.title: Is Bluetooth On
actions.description: Returns whether Bluetooth is on or off.

actions.name: isConnectedToVPN
actions.title: Is Connected to VPN (iOS-only)
actions.description: Returns whether the device is connected to a VPN.

actions.name: isDarkMode

actions.name: isLowPowerMode
actions.title: Is Low Power Mode On

actions.name: isSilentModeOn

actions.description: Returns whether the silent switch (mute) is enabled on the device.

actions.name: randomColor
actions.title: Random Color
actions.description: Gets a random color. Returns the color in Hex format.

actions.name: randomDateTime
actions.title: Random Date and Time
actions.description: Returns a random date and time in the given range.

actions.name: randomEmoji
actions.title: Random Emoticon
actions.description: Returns a random emoticon (also known as smiley).

actions.name: randomFloatingPointNumber
actions.title: Random Floating-Point Number
actions.description: Returns a random floating-point number between the given minimum and maximum.

actions.title: Random Text
actions.description: Returns random text of the given length. This can be useful as a placeholder, token, etc. If you specify a "seed", the generated text will always be the same if the seed is the same.

actions.name: removeDuplicateLines
actions.title: Remove Duplicate Lines
actions.description: Removes duplicate lines from the input text. Empty or whitespace-only lines are not considered duplicates.
actions.example:
removeDuplicateLines(text: "This is a test
This is a test", caseInsensitive: false)

actions.name: removeDuplicatesFromList
actions.title: Remove Duplicates from List
actions.description: Removes duplicates from the input list. List elements are coerced to text before being compared.

actions.name: removeEmoji
actions.title: Remove Emojis

actions.name: removeEmptyLines
actions.title: Remove Empty Lines
actions.description: Removes empty and whitespace-only lines from the input text.

actions.name: removeFromList
actions.title: Remove from List
actions.description: Removes items from the input list. It uses 1-based indexing. Even though the description says this action accepts input of type "Files", it accepts any type.
actions.example: removeFromList(list: [ShortcutInput, Clibpoard, CurrentDate], action: index, index: 2, rangeLowerBound: 2, rangeUpperBound: 2)

actions.name: removeNonPrintableCharacters
actions.title: Remove Non-Printable Characters
actions.description: Removes non-printable (invisible) Unicode characters from the input text, excluding normal whitespace characters. This can be useful to clean up input text which might contain things like left-to-right embedding, control characters, etc.
actions.example: removeNonPrintableCharacters(text: "T𝅸here ar e some h𝅸idde𝅸n cha𝅸rac ters in this tㅤext")

actions.name: reverseList
actions.title: Reverse List
actions.description: Reverses the input list. Even though the description says this action accepts input of type "Files", it can handle lists of any type.

actions.name: sampleColor
actions.title: Sample Color from Screen (macOS-only)
actions.description: Lets you pick a color from the screen. Returns the color in Hex format.

actions.name: sendFeedback
actions.title: Send Feedback
actions.description: Lets you send feedback, action ideas, bug reports, etc, directly to the developer of the Actions app. You can also email me at sindresorhus@gmail.com if you prefer that.

actions.name: setFileCreationModificationDate
actions.title: Set Creation and Modification Date of File
actions.description: Sets the creation and modification date of a file to a new value.

actions.name: shuffleList
actions.title: Shuffle List
actions.description: Shuffles the input list. Even though the description says this action accepts input of type "Files", it can handle lists of any type.
actions.example: shuffleList(list: [ShortcutInput, CurrentDate, Clipboard], shouldLimit: true, limit: 1)

actions.name: sortList
actions.title: Sort List
actions.description: Sorts the input list. Supports a list of text and numbers.
actions.example: sortList(list: ["Awesome Item", "Awesome Item 2"], ascending: false, sortType: natural)

actions.name: spellOutNumber
actions.title: Spell Out Number
actions.description: Spells out the input number. For example, "one thousand". If a ActionsLocale is not specified, the system ActionsLocale is used.

actions.name: transformText
actions.title: Transform Text
actions.description: Transforms the input text to camel case, pascal case, snake case, constant case, or dash case.

actions.name: transformTextWithJavaScript
actions.title: Transform Text with JavaScript
actions.description: Transforms the input text with the given JavaScript code. The input text is available in a global variable named $text. You are expected to return a string. The code must be synchronous. The code is excuted with JavaScriptCore (same as used in Safari), not JXA.

actions.name: trimWhitespace
actions.title: Trim Whitespace

actions.name: truncateList
actions.title: Truncate List
actions.description: Truncates the input list to the given limit by removing items from the end. Even though the description says this action accepts input of type "Files", it accepts any type.

actions.name: unixTimeToDate

actions.description: Gets the date for the input Unix time. Unix time (also known as Epoch time) is a system for describing a point in time — the number of seconds that have elapsed since the Unix epoch.

actions.name: universalVariables
actions.title: Universal Variables
actions.description:
Manipulate universal variables.
An internet connection is required.
Public values are readable and writable by everyone.
Protected values are readable by everyone and writable by the creator.
Private values are readable and writable by only the creator.
Set overwrites a value.
Get retrieves a value.
Add adds an item to a value.
Delete deletes a value.
Remove deletes an item from a value.
Get all retrieves the name of all the values you have set.

actions.name: parameterizedRunScript
actions.title: Run Script
actions.description: Runs a script in Scriptable. The parameter can be accessed using args.shortcutParameter. This parameter can be a text, list, dictionary or a file. When passing a file as input the action will attempt to read the file as JSON or a plain text. If the file cannot be read as JSON or plain text, a path to the file will be passed instead. Use args.plainTexts, args.images, args.urls and args.fileURLs to read the other input parameters. When passing large images and files as input, the script may fail due to memory constraints. In that case you should enable "Run In App". Use JavaScript's "return" keyword or Script.setShortcutOutput() to output a value. In case you don't output a value, add Script.complete() to indicate that your script have finished running.
actions.syntax: parameterizedRunScript(fileName: , parameter: , texts: , urls: , images: , files: , runInApp: )
actions.example: parameterizedRunScript(fileName: "Display", parameter: Clipboard, texts: [Red, Blue, Green], urls: ["https://jellycuts.com"], images: image, files: file, runInApp: false)

actions.name: refreshAllWidgets

actions.name: runScriptInline
actions.title: Run Inline Script
actions.description: Runs a script in Scriptable. The parameter can be accessed using args.shortcutParameter. This parameter can be a text, list, dictionary or a file. When passing a file as input the action will attempt to read the file as JSON or a plain text. If the file cannot be read as JSON or plain text, a path to the file will be passed instead. Use args.plainTexts, args.images, args.urls and args.fileURLs to read the other input parameters. When passing large images and files as input, the script may fail due to memory constraints. In that case you should enable "Run In App". Use JavaScript's "return" keyword or Script.setShortcutOutput() to output a value. In case you don't output a value, add Script.complete() to indicate that your script have finished running.
actions.syntax: runScriptInline(script: , parameter: , texts: , urls: , images: , files: , runInApp: )
